confidence_reason: Current source defines the joint push and pad rules, and the full ordinary-key campaign route clears; human interpretation and hardware key rollover remain unmeasured.

confirmed: The TEAM cargo, x2 pad, powered ferry, Isp STOP, Pac RESCUE, and gap inferred from idle captures are real.
A joint hero push begins the demonstrated both-exit route.
missed_mechanics: The heavy sac itself has weight two on an any pad, so heroes can leave TEAM after parking it.
STOP supplies ferry power as well as braking it; Pac RESCUE later latches power and gates.
incorrect_inferences: The first pass left open whether two heroes must occupy TEAM x2; source shows one heavy crate meets its weight.
The first pass treated the glucose condition as a separate pickup possibility; the powered ferry is controlled by STOP/RESCUE, not sparks.
changed_judgments: Timing changes from unknown to 1 because STOP and RESCUE make ferry movement repeatable from safe banks.
Recovery changes from unknown to 2: cargo attempts are reversible but a slime fall resets the dependent sequence.
Reasoning, cooperation, novelty, and clarity remain elevated for the joint-push-to-single-heavy-weight transfer, now with a confirmed cause rather than idle inference.
unresolved: Whether new human players infer the heavy crate's weight without using Hint, and physical shared-keyboard comfort, remain unknown.

single_operator_note: The joint push requires simultaneous Isp-right and Pac-right key presses; one operator must make the chord alone, an added demand outside the two-human baseline.
